subject: Next steps: ownership roster, systems in-scope & security intake
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Nicole Grant <nicole@quantifyhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: ownership roster, systems in-scope & security intake

Hi Nicole —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:  

Call highlights (1-line):
- Use case: secure, audited inference for clinical insights pipeline (batch + real-time).
- Primary success metrics: 99th-p latency under 350ms for embedding requests and audit trail for PHI flows.
- Competitive constraints: quantized open models + cost targets for monthly inference spend.

Confirmed owners (please correct if wrong):
- Economic buyer: Nicole Grant (you)
- InfoSec reviewer: Priya Shah (InfoSec) — you introduced her on the call
- Procurement: Sanjay Rao (Procurement)

Immediate asks / proposals:
1) Security intake: we’ll send our short questionnaire + SOC2 and data flow checklist. Can Priya confirm the systems in-scope (internal APIs, analytics DB, vendor-managed logs)?
2) Procurement timeline: Sanjay — do you have a PO cadence or standard contract route (SOW v MSA + addendum)?
3) Decision criteria: can you share the top 3 must-haves for a vendor (e.g., SOC2, data residency, SSO + SCIM)?
4) Quick follow-up: propose 30-min security intake call next week to walk questionnaire answers and confirm boundaries.

Attachments: redwood-security-overview.pdf (short SOC2/controls summary) and arch-boundary-quick.png (proposed systems diagram).

Proposed times: Thu 10/8 10:00–10:30am PT or Mon 10/12 11:00–11:30am PT. If those don’t work, share alternatives.

Thanks — happy to coordinate the calendar.

—Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Solutions (Redwood Inference)
stephanie@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: redwood-security-overview.pdf (6pg), arch-boundary-quick.png (PNG, 440KB)

From: Nicole Grant <nicole@quantifyhealth.com>

Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: ownership roster, systems in-scope & security intake

Stephanie —

Appreciate the recap. This matches our internal notes. Quick confirmations and a couple requests:  

- Economic buyer confirmed: I’ll own sign-off for product/PO up to $250k. Anything above goes to our CFO.
- InfoSec reviewer: Priya will lead the technical review — she wants the intake questionnaire before the call so she can annotate answers.
- Procurement: Sanjay handles legal/PO; typical timeline is 3–4 weeks for standard MSAs, faster for addendums.

Request: please include our legal team on any MSA redline threads once you have the initial doc. CC: legal@quantifyhealth.com when you share the draft.

Available for the intake call: Mon 10/12 11:00am PT works for me. Priya asked if you can provide the SOC2 report and a sample DPA by EOD Friday so she can pre-scan.

Thanks — looking forward to the intake call.

-Nicole
VP Product, Quantify Health
nicole@quantifyhealth.com

Thanks for the quick replies, Nicole. Looping in Neha from our Security Ops team to own the intake thread and pre-call artifacts. Neha — welcome; Priya (Quantify) will be your primary peer for the review.

Neha and I propose the following owner split and deliverables before the Mon 10/12 call:  
- Redwood deliverables (Neha / Rishi): SOC2 Type II evidence (PDF), DPA template, short answers to the attached 20-question intake (we’ll put responses in the shared Drive).
- Action for Quantify (Priya): confirm systems in-scope (names + IP ranges if possible), any external integrations that handle PHI, and the minimal retention window required for audit logs.
- Procurement (Sanjay): confirm whether Quantify requires vendor onboarding questionnaire and whether your legal wants redlines pre-call.

Two notes on scope we observed in the demo — please confirm:  
1) Data flow: Are inference requests sent to a staging analytics cluster (hosted in us-west-2) or to an internal on-prem API? That will determine whether our private deployment option is needed.
2) Logging: if raw PHI is logged in request payloads, we’ll need to discuss masking/agent-side filters in the first intake call.

We’ll upload the SOC2 and draft DPA to the Drive link below by EOD Friday so Priya can pre-scan.

—Rishi
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
